evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~3.04 Torr through the ramp and early growth, then rising steadily at ~0.05 Torr per 120 s to 3.329 Torr
Argon flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the extra gas is not coming from the MFC
Temperature holding at 750 °C with heater power steady at ~46%, so the thermal side looks normal
No O2 exhaust sensor installed, so air ingress can't be checked directly

args.missing_evidence: To tell a blocked exhaust from a leaking seal: a leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the gas off and the pump valve closed, a check of how pressure responds to a change in Ar flow, or an O2 or residual-gas reading at the exhaust.
